description: This file defines the UserDAO class, which provides database access methods for User entities, including save, findById, findByEmail, findAll, delete, and update operations.

classes.name: UserDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for User entity, handling CRUD operations with SQL database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts a new User into the database and sets its generated ID.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Users from the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing User's email and name.
